title: Clustering for Protein Representation Learning
caption: Figure 1. Overview of our iterative neural clustering pipeline for protein representation learning: (a) input protein with amino acids, (b) iterative clustering algorithm which repeatedly stacks three steps ⟳(4⇤5), (c) output can be seen as the critical amino acids of the protein, (d) output amino acids used for classiﬁcation. The details of our iterative neural clustering method can be seen in §3.2.
